_note: VISUAL EXTRACTION — read from rendered statement pages, NOT from the PDFs' text layers. HBL and KBL FY2076-77 use a legacy/custom-encoded font whose text layer is gibberish, so the text parser cannot read these pages. The rendered pages are legible, and every value below was read off the page image and then checked by the accounting identity (total liabilities + total equity = total assets) for BOTH the current and the previous column. This file is the saved source of record: the extract runner and the manual-corrections script both load it and merge it into the raw JSON at extract time, so the panel looks like a regular extraction — but the method stays labelled 'visual_page_read' in the raw JSON, never disguised as text extraction.
